name: Élodie Dubois
bio:
Élodie Dubois has always been driven by a passion for engineering and speed. From a young age, she disassembled and reassembled anything she could get her hands on, developing an intuitive understanding of mechanics. This led her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering with a specialization in motorsport at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris. After graduating, she quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a junior engineer and quickly impressing with her analytical abilities and problem-solving skills. 

Élodie's approach to her role as Technical Director is meticulous and data-driven. She believes in empowering her team to push boundaries while ensuring rigorous testing and adherence to safety protocols. She is known for her ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies, making her an invaluable asset to any team. Her demanding nature stems from her relentless pursuit of excellence and a desire to see her team achieve its full potential. 

What sets Élodie apart is her innate ability to identify and solve problems before they escalate. She's a proactive leader, constantly seeking ways to improve performance and efficiency. Her colleagues know her as the one who meticulously examines every detail, ensuring nothing is overlooked, which has helped her deliver exceptional results in a short period of time.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Élodie is a slender woman with an intense gaze and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of French coffee to be available in the team garage.
